# WDI Worldbank Visualizations

A Shiny application, built as a
[golem](https://thinkr-open.github.io/golem/) package, for exploring
World Bank development indicators through interactive country
comparison, indicator comparison, population pyramid, ranked bar chart,
correlation scatter, and choropleth map views.

# Installation Instructions

## install R

installation instructions can be found here:
<https://cran.r-project.org/>\
\## install RStudio IDE (optional but a good idea)\
installation instructions can be found here:
<https://posit.co/downloads/>

open RStudio and type in the console:

    install.packages("devtools")
    library(devtools)
    install_github("sedzinfo/golemworldbank")

Note: `install_github()` may fail for this repository because package
data files are tracked with Git LFS and GitHub source tarballs can
contain LFS pointer files instead of binary `.rda` data.

# Alternative installation

Since the data range from 1960 onwards and there are thousands of
indicators, we use git large file storage. Since the last update where
the data file became larger than 100mb git will not accept directly so
large files. As a result the traditional installation may not work. Use
one of the following reliable options:

1.  Clone the repository with Git LFS enabled and install locally:

&nbsp;

    git lfs install
    git clone https://github.com/sedzinfo/golemworldbank.git

Then in R:

    devtools::install_local("golemworldbank")

2.  Download the full repository and regenerate package data locally by
    running `financial_indicators.R` and then `generate_package.R`.

# Usage

    library(golemworldbank)
    run_app()

# Update data

In order to update the data: 1. run the financial_indicators.R script 2.
run the generate_package.R script

The data updates almost yearly so there is no need for frequent updates

## Features

Each feature below is a Shiny module rendered as its own tab in the app:

- 📊 **Country Comparison**: plot one indicator’s value over time as one
  line per selected country
- 📈 **Indicator Comparison**: plot several indicators’ values over time
  for a single country
- 👥 **Pyramid**: animated population pyramid by age group and sex, for
  a selected country, over time
- 📉 **Barplot**: animated ranked bar chart of one indicator per
  country, ranked by value in the most recent year
- 🔍 **Scatterplot**: animated bubble scatter correlating two
  indicators, bubble size by population, colored by region
- 🗺️ **Map**: animated choropleth map of one indicator by country, over
  time
- 📋 **Index**: searchable table listing every indicator name available
  in the data

## Data

The package ships four lazy-loaded datasets, sourced from [World Bank
Open Data](https://data.worldbank.org):

- `mfi` — long-format indicator values, one row per
  country/indicator/year (`Country Code`, `Country Name`,
  `Indicator Name`, `Year`, `value`).
- `mfi_population` — long-format population counts by five-year age
  group and sex, used by the Pyramid tab.
- `country_code` — country/region reference metadata (region, income
  group, and other World Bank classifications), used to join region info
  in the Scatterplot tab.
- `indicator_info` — the World Bank topic and definition of every
  indicator in `mfi`, shown in the Index tab.

Full column-level documentation is available via
[`?mfi`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mfi.md),
[`?mfi_population`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mfi_population.md),
[`?country_code`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/country_code.md),
and
[`?indicator_info`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/indicator_info.md).

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Git LFS Setup

Large files (e.g. datasets) are stored using [Git
LFS](https://git-lfs.com). Follow the steps below to clone the
repository and retrieve them.

### 1. Install Git LFS (one-time setup)

**Ubuntu/Debian:**

``` bash
sudo apt install git-lfs
git lfs install
```

**Mac:**

``` bash
brew install git-lfs
git lfs install
```

**Windows:**

Download and run the installer from <https://git-lfs.com>, then:

``` bash
git lfs install
```

### 2. Clone the repository

``` bash
git clone https://github.com/sedzinfo/golemworldbank.git
cd golemworldbank
```

### 3. Pull the LFS files

``` bash
git lfs pull
```

> **Note:** If you cloned the repository *before* installing Git LFS and
> large files appear as small pointer files, run:
>
> ``` bash
> git lfs install
> git lfs pull
> ```

To verify that LFS files downloaded correctly:

``` bash
git lfs ls-files
```

# Package index

## Datasets

- [`country_code`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/country_code.md)
  : Country and region reference table
- [`indicator_change()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/indicator_change.md)
  : Indicators that rose or fell between two years for one country
- [`indicator_info`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/indicator_info.md)
  : Indicator topics and definitions
- [`mfi`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mfi.md) :
  World Bank indicator values
- [`mfi_population`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mfi_population.md)
  : Population by age group and sex

## UI

Internal functions not meant to run independently

- [`mod_bar_ui()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mod_bar_ui.md)
  : Barplot tab - UI
- [`mod_change_ui()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mod_change_ui.md)
  : Change (%) tab - UI
- [`mod_country_comp_ui()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mod_country_comp_ui.md)
  : Country Comparison tab - UI
- [`mod_index_table_ui()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mod_index_table_ui.md)
  : Index tab - UI
- [`mod_indicator_comp_ui()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mod_indicator_comp_ui.md)
  : Indicator Comparison tab - UI
- [`mod_map_ui()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mod_map_ui.md)
  : Map tab - UI
- [`mod_pyramid_ui()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mod_pyramid_ui.md)
  : Pyramid tab - UI
- [`mod_scatter_ui()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mod_scatter_ui.md)
  : Scatterplot tab - UI

## Server

Internal functions not meant to run independently

- [`mod_bar_server()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mod_bar_server.md)
  : Barplot tab - server
- [`mod_change_server()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mod_change_server.md)
  : Change (%) tab - server
- [`mod_country_comp_server()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mod_country_comp_server.md)
  : Country Comparison tab - server
- [`mod_index_table_server()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mod_index_table_server.md)
  : Index tab - server
- [`mod_indicator_comp_server()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mod_indicator_comp_server.md)
  : Indicator Comparison tab - server
- [`mod_map_server()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mod_map_server.md)
  : Map tab - server
- [`mod_pyramid_server()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mod_pyramid_server.md)
  : Pyramid tab - server
- [`mod_scatter_server()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/mod_scatter_server.md)
  : Scatterplot tab - server

## Plot

- [`plot_bar()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/plot_bar.md)
  : Build an animated ranked bar chart
- [`plot_cor()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/plot_cor.md)
  : Build an animated correlation bubble scatter plot
- [`plot_country_comp()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/plot_country_comp.md)
  : Build a country comparison line chart
- [`plot_indicator_comp()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/plot_indicator_comp.md)
  : Build an indicator comparison line chart
- [`plot_map()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/plot_map.md)
  : Build an animated choropleth map
- [`plot_pyramid()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/plot_pyramid.md)
  : Build an animated population pyramid

## Render

- [`render_change_table()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/render_change_table.md)
  :

  Render one table of
  [`indicator_change()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/indicator_change.md)
  as a DataTable

- [`render_index_table()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/render_index_table.md)
  : Build the indicator index DataTable

- [`run_app()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/run_app.md)
  : Run the World Bank Indicators Explorer

## Helpers

- [`animation_buttons()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/animation_buttons.md)
  : Pause and Stop buttons for an animated plotly chart
- [`format_value()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/format_value.md)
  : Format numbers compactly to 3 significant digits
- [`keep_legend_clicks()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/keep_legend_clicks.md)
  : Keep the legend clicks of an animated plotly chart
